SELECT VARCHAR(k.TABNAME, 18) AS TABNAME, VARCHAR(k.COLNAME, 10) AS COLNAME, k.COLSEQ FROM SYSCAT.KEYCOLUSE k JOIN SYSCAT.TABCONST c ON c.CONSTNAME = k.CONSTNAME AND c.TABSCHEMA = k.TABSCHEMA AND c.TABNAME = k.TABNAME WHERE c.TYPE = 'P' AND k.TABSCHEMA = 'APP' AND k.TABNAME IN ('LIBREDB_VF_TYPES', 'LIBREDB_VF_HIDDEN', 'ORDERS') ORDER BY 1, 3

------------------ ---------- ------
LIBREDB_VF_HIDDEN  ID              1

ORDERS             ID              1
